name: application-reaction-bar
title: Reaction Bar
description: Aggregated emoji reaction pills with per-reaction counts, a toggleable reacted-by-you state, and an add-reaction trigger.
useWhen: Showing the aggregate reaction counts on a comment, message, or post, where multiple users can react with the same emoji.
You need users to be able to add their own reaction or toggle an existing one they already added.
Pairing with `comment-thread` or `chat-bubbles`, using `emoji-picker` as the add-reaction popover content.
avoidWhen: You need the full emoji browsing/search experience, not aggregated counts — use `emoji-picker` directly instead.
Only one reaction per item is allowed (not per-emoji aggregation) — a single like/heart toggle button is simpler.
Reaction counts aren't meaningful in your product (e.g. single-user context) — skip the aggregation entirely.
responsiveBehavior: Pills wrap onto multiple lines via flex-wrap as more reactions accumulate, rather than overflowing or truncating.
accessibility: The pill group has role="group" with an aria-label describing it as reactions.

Each reaction pill is a real toggle button with aria-pressed reflecting whether the current user has reacted, and its aria-label states the emoji name, count, and reacted state as text — not relying on the emoji glyph or color alone.
The add-reaction control is a dashed-border icon button with an explicit aria-label, visually distinct from the filled reaction pills.

variants.title: Reaction Bar
variants.description: Three reaction pills (one reacted by you) and an add-reaction trigger.
accessibility: Toggling a reaction updates real count and aria-pressed state together, so they never drift out of sync.

variants.title: Reaction Bar (Dark)
variants.description: Reaction bar adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Reacted-state pill colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
